title: The context bar is drawn in colour at every level
body:
The context row above the status line (`context_line` in `header.rs`, 31371bd) draws the percentage and the filled `▰` glyphs in the muted colour below 80%, yellow above 80% and red above 95%. The empty `▱` glyphs are always muted. Below 80% the whole bar is grey, and Jack wants colour on it.

## Proposal

The percentage and the filled glyphs are green below 80%, yellow from 80% and red above 95%. The empty glyphs stay muted, so the filled part stands out.

## Open

- Whether green is the right colour for the normal range, or the palette's `accent`.
